verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-managed software. The docs show running it yourself via the Docker container image, installing it on Kubernetes/OpenShift with the Operator, and switching to a production database such as PostgreSQL. User data can also stay in your existing LDAP/Active Directory, or in another relational store through a custom provider, and community reports confirm long-running self-hosted production use. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party database configuration docs (supported vendors, connection settings) beyond a single getting-started line.
